  • CI matrix: Windows x64, macOS x64, macOS arm64, Linux x64 (Ubuntu), optional Linux arm64.
  • Checks: fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests, benches (non-failing thresholds), plugin compat suite.

  • Stable builds: tagged semver; signed; changelog generated from conventional commits.

  • Versioning: semver for product; protocol version separate; plugin API semver separate.
